lines.text: Many learners say: I wonder where is the bank.
Better: I wonder where the bank is.
After I wonder, use normal order: where it is.
Where she lives! I wonder where she lives.

data.wrong: I wonder where is the bank.
data.right: I wonder where the bank is.
data.why: After I wonder, use normal order: where it is.
